item.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
item.description: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

item.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
item.description: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

item.title: School roof collapse kills at least 29, injures more than 3 dozen in Pakistan
item.description: The roof of a private school collapsed in northwestern Pakistan on Thursday, killing at least 28 children and a female teacher and injuring more than 50 other people.

item.title: Aboard an icebreaker, a writer got a closer look at the Arctic's 'Sea Change'
item.description: As polar ice melts in the Arctic, shipping lanes are opening up, making the region a new zone of superpower competition. Writer Rana Foroohar explains the stakes in Sea Change.
